summary: Iter25 (Pricing fix + Invoice Toolkit + Geo-fence + Admin/Pro dead-end fixes) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14 PASSED + 1 intentional skip across two test files (existing test_iter25_toolkit_geofence.py + new test_iter25_extras.py). Frontend: ALL 20+ critical flows in the request passed including Stripe toolkit checkout URL generation, Pro Billing pricing display (29.99 + excl-VAT footnote + 35.99 brutto), Toolkit card + upgrade button, Kleinunternehmer toggle, Invoice details sub-tab via ?tab=invoice_details deep link, geo-fence Leaflet map + slider + value testids, /my-invoices listing, click-to-invoice from completed job, Admin Verifications modal with Approve/Reject, Admin Users + Reviews inline detail expansion, Admin Billing disabled-button state when no hosted_invoice_url, Pro Delete Account routing to Privacy tab. One MINOR DX issue and one cosmetic backend response bug found (DB writes are correct, only response shape misleading).

minor.issue: Response body returns {is_licensed: null, is_insured: <new>} when only insurance_status is in the payload (and vice versa). The DB write is correct (verified via re-fetch from /api/admin/verifications) and only sets the supplied fields, but the response misrepresents the cross-field as null. Frontend should refetch state from DB or backend should return the merged current state.

integration_issues.issue: ?tab=invoice_details DOES open Invoice details sub-tab (✓ per spec). But ?tab=services does NOT auto-open the Services & Areas tab — page lands on default About Me. Inconsistent with the invoice_details deep-link behaviour. Geo-fence map + slider + value all render correctly when user clicks the Services & Areas tab manually.

action_items: MINOR: PATCH /api/admin/pros/{id}/verify should return the FULL merged verification state (read from DB after $set), not just the fields that were in the request payload. Currently returns null for the field that was not in the payload, which could mislead the admin UI (DB write itself is correct).

MINOR DX: Pro Settings tab routing accepts ?tab=invoice_details but ignores ?tab=services (and likely other tab keys). Either honour all tab keys in the routing useEffect, or document that only invoice_details supports deep-linking.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/admin_routes.py:132 — return statement returns updates.get('is_licensed') which is None when only insurance was updated. Either re-fetch the doc post-update or accumulate fields properly: e.g., return {'is_licensed': updates.get('is_licensed', raw.get('is_licensed')), 'is_insured': updates.get('is_insured', raw.get('is_insured'))}.

backend/routes/pro_invoicing_routes.py — POST /api/pro-invoices/{id}/mark-paid returns {message: 'Marked paid'} instead of the updated invoice object. Less RESTful; frontend has to re-GET to know the new status. Suggest returning the updated invoice.

backend/services/pro_invoicing.py:91 — _split_lines reads li.get('unit_net') but Pydantic schema requires field name 'unit_net'. The /pro-invoices test file initially failed with 'unit_price_net' — naming is consistent in code but undocumented; consider exposing a friendlier alias.

Frontend ProSettingsPage useEffect that reads ?tab= only fires for 'invoice_details' — generalise to all known tab keys (about_me, services, portfolio, invoice_details, notifications, account, privacy) for consistent deep-linking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter25 fully green. The Pro user pro@test.com is mutated by the geo-fence test (radius set back to 0 at end). The toolkit gating test SKIPS because pro@test.com has has_invoice_toolkit=true in this env; to exercise the 402 path you would need a different pro without toolkit, OR an admin endpoint to revoke. Stripe checkout endpoints DO hit the live Stripe API and return real checkout.stripe.com URLs (we never actually pay). Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_extras.py is the new addition; original /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_toolkit_geofence.py is unchanged.
rca of the issue: Issue 1 (admin verify response): the verify_pro endpoint sets only the fields supplied in `data` (correct DB behaviour) but returns `updates.get('is_licensed')` / `updates.get('is_insured')` which is None for whichever field was not in the payload. Fix: merge with `raw` (the pre-update doc) when constructing the response. Issue 2 (geo-fence deep link): the ?tab= query param logic in ProSettingsPage only handles the 'invoice_details' key; other tab keys are silently ignored. Fix: generalise the URL-→state effect to a switch over all valid tab keys.
